dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical reduction in 2D lateral width from the mid-body section towards the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: None visible; the lateral margins appear smooth and continuous where the skin-water interface is discernible.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity reflectance across the primary dorsal surface area.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single dark, crescentic high-contrast feature observed in the anterior cephalic region.

other_distinctive_markers: The blowhole presents as a distinct, dark high-contrast aperture against the white dorsal field.
